H1_THRESHOLD_HEADROOM_EXISTS.claim: at least one detector has a non-trivial fraction of units with CORRECTABLE_SAFE = 1
H1_THRESHOLD_HEADROOM_EXISTS.minimum_continuation: >= 20% of units OR >= 8 units (at least one satisfied)

H2_DIRECTION_IDENTIFIABILITY.claim: normal-only deformation can predict sign(tau*_SAFE - tau_source) significantly better than a trivial baseline

H3_MAGNITUDE_IDENTIFIABILITY.claim: normal-only deformation has a stable monotonic / regression relation with delta_tau*_SAFE

H4_DETECTOR_DEPENDENCE.claim: different detectors show substantial differences in correctability prevalence, delta_tau* distribution, and the deformation -> threshold relationship

H5_FEW_NORMAL_STABILITY.claim: the above information is preserved with sufficient stability at K=8 target-normal support

H6_SAFE_DEPLOYABLE_ACTUATOR_EXISTS.claim: at least one pre-registered simple normal-only threshold rule achieves actual benefit under strict held-out evaluation
